chiral_partner_B2_to_B1.staggering: In-band BM1 and interband BM1 exhibit opposite odd-even staggering phases
chiral_partner_B2_to_B1.crossover_E2: Interband Delta I = 2 crossover transitions absent or extremely weak
chiral_partner_B2_to_B1.physical_mechanism: Aperiodic chiral vibration / static chirality perpendicular to principal planes

wobbling_partner_B3_to_B1.interband_multipolarity: E2 dominated (E2 fraction increases with spin and reaches ~90%)
wobbling_partner_B3_to_B1.staggering: In-band BM1 has opposite staggering phase to Band 1
wobbling_partner_B3_to_B1.physical_mechanism: Triaxial collective core precession with partial angular momentum transfer

summary.conclusion: 74Br establishes the definitive experimental comparator between chirality and wobbling via direct DSAM lifetimes: chiral partner B2 decays by M1-dominated links (<10% E2) with staggering, while wobbling partner B3 decays by E2-dominated links reaching 90% E2, proving that M1-dominated decay in other claimed wobblers (e.g. 130Ba) belongs to the chiral/signature partner class.
